entities.name: Norse Greenlanders
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Erik the Red established Norse settlements in Greenland that survived 500 years. His son Leif Erikson reached North America (Vinland) around 1000 CE — the first Europeans in the Americas. The colonies mysteriously disappeared by 1500.
